display.label: Oral Health — Infants, First Oral Visit (quarterly)

notes: Oral Health — infants 0-11 months, first oral visit only. Only 5 geographic rows per period (NIR + 3 provinces + Bacolod HUC), no city/municipality breakdown, unlike other programs. All 4 quarters are stacked as row-blocks within the single 'Quarterly' tab (col 3 = 'Quarter' text '1st Quarter'..'4th Quarter') — period_filter_column/period_labels scope each upload to that quarter's 5 rows (same D6 mechanism as Family Planning). Percentage is always recomputed from raw counts (Total/Population), matching the project's standing rule of never trusting a source-computed % — this sheet's own % formula is correct, unlike Quarterly_1's (see ohc_general_population.json), but recomputing costs nothing and stays consistent. Quarterly only: the workbook's own Annual tab is not ingested (an annual view is derived from the quarterly data already stored).
